entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • identity WebAPIs don't respect the configured fromat (json/msgpack) #64279

  • Project stopped working when published with /__w/1/s/src/mono/mono/metadata/assembly.c:2718, condition `<disabled>' not met #64272
  • Instructions On OpenApiEnumValuesDescriptionExtension in .net 10 #64269

    Backlog
